spec.epoch_selection: minimum inner-validation unweighted NLL; earliest exact tie
spec.refit: fresh initialization on all outer-training patients for selected epoch count
spec.time_bins: four event-quantile bins fitted on the current fitting patients only
spec.finite_end: max observation time among current fitting patients + 1e-6
spec.beyond_fit_end: administrative censoring only for the encoded discrete NLL target
spec.sampling: uniform shuffled patients, no inverse-class resampling
spec.primary_curve_metrics: IPCW Brier at 12/36/60 months and IBS[12,60], 97 fixed grid points
spec.native_ranking: negative sum of four native survival outputs; canonical untruncated observations
spec.continuous_curve: S(0)=1 plus post-interval probabilities at finite right boundaries; linear interpolation
spec.full_mean_mae: diagnostic only, additional Mean/Linear tail convention, nonfinite values retained as flags
spec.limitation: Post-hoc revised protocol; not a replication of VLSA Table 9 or an independent untouched test
